headlines.description: — Pascal Siakam scored 28 points and Ivica Zubac finished with 20 points and 12 rebounds as the Indiana Pacers beat the Washington Wizards 114-101 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Siakam, Zubac power the Pacers to a 114-101 win over the Wizards

events.name: Cleveland Cavaliers at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — James Harden scored a season-high 32 points, more than double his average during a tough start to 2026-27, and the Cleveland Cavaliers beat the New York Knicks 115-107 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: James Harden scores a season-high 32 points as the Cavaliers beat the Knicks 115-107

headlines.description: — Jayson Tatum made the tying and go-ahead free throws with 25.2 seconds remaining and the Boston Celtics overcame a 22-point deficit to beat the Toronto Raptors 98-93 on Wednesday night, extending their winning streak to five.
headlines.shortLinkText: Celtics win 5th straight, overcoming 22-point deficit to beat Raptors 98-93

events.name: San Antonio Spurs at Chicago Bulls

headlines.description: — Victor Wembanyama scored 32 points, Dylan Harper had 18 points, 10 assists and four steals and the San Antonio Spurs won their 10th straight game, overcoming a 22-point deficit to beat the Chicago Bulls 124-119 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wembanyama, Harper lead Spurs to 10th straight win, 124-119 over Bulls

headlines.description: — Jamal Murray scored 17 of his 30 points in the fourth quarter, Nikola Jokic added 27 points, 11 rebounds and eight assists, and the Denver Nuggets held off the Memphis Grizzlies 123-118 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jamal Murray, Nikola Jokic lead Nuggets to 123-118 win over Grizzlies

events.name: Los Angeles Lakers at Milwaukee Bucks

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic scored 32 points, Sandro Mamukelashvili added 23 and Austin Reaves 18 as the Los Angeles Lakers extended their winning streak to seven games with a 123-112 win over the Milwaukee Bucks on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Doncic, Mamukelashvili and Reaves lead Lakers past Bucks 123-112 for 7th straight win

events.name: Brooklyn Nets at New Orleans Pelicans

headlines.description: — Egor Demin returned from a six-game injury absence to score 22 points, Michael Porter Jr. also scored 22, and the Brooklyn Nets beat New Orleans 145-111 on Wednesday night, handing the Pelicans their fourth consecutive loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Egor Demin scores 22 in his return as the Nets rout the Pelicans 145-111

headlines.description: — Franz Wagner matched a career high with 38 points and had eight rebounds to lead the Orlando Magic to a 123-108 victory over Utah on Wednesday night, the 10th straight loss for the Jazz.
headlines.shortLinkText: Franz Wagner scores 38, helps Magic send Jazz to their 10th straight loss

events.name: Golden State Warriors at Houston Rockets

headlines.description: — Kevin Durant scored 20 points, Alperen Sengun and Amen Thompson added 19 and the Houston Rockets snapped Golden State’s eight-game winning streak with a 115-108 victory on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rockets beat Warriors 115-108 to end Golden State’s 8-game winning streak after Curry's early exit

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Portland Trail Blazers

headlines.description: — Deni Avdija had 28 points, Damian Lillard scored 18 points, and the Portland Trail Blazers completed a two-game sweep of the Oklahoma City Thunder with a 118-108 win on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trail Blazers sweep the Thunder with a 118-108 win
